title: statusline r13 UX: state-unreadable scope exceeds malformed-only coverage
description: Round 13. Lens: ux (validator: DR). Defect: absent or permission-denied state files have no parse location, no fixture, and sit outside the never-panic guarantee scoped to malformed input — the branch that promises to speak on every surface can fall mute or panic. Citations verified: contract:163, :188, :173, :217. Proposed: resolved-candidate (read-failure kinds enumerated — malformed, absent, permission/IO; diagnostic names the kind with parse location when parse; never-panic widened to any read failure; fixtures for all kinds).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: read-failure kinds enumerated (malformed, absent, permission/IO); every kind takes the broken-state branch; the diagnostic names the kind with parse location when parse; never-panic widened to any read failure at the trust boundary; fixtures for all kinds in corpus and criterion. Revision: Status bullet + criterion + corpus + trust boundary.
